title: Unicode, emoji and CJK tokenization
why: The single most likely place for tiktoken and gpt-tokenizer to disagree. Multi-codepoint grapheme clusters (ZWJ families, skin-tone modifiers, flag sequences), CJK/Hangul/Devanagari, RTL scripts, combining vs. precomposed accents, invisible format characters and astral-plane math alphanumerics all cross byte-pair boundaries in ways a merge-table revision can move. Every token number below is produced by the SDK's own tokenizer at build time, so a divergence changes the rendered output and fails the golden.
